name: itsz-tdeck-realtime-gps-compass
description: Use GPS course as a near-real-time compass heading source on the ITSZ T-Deck, refresh compass-capable frames faster when GPS heading is available, apply the low-color ITSZ Classic T-Deck UI skin, patch the TFT map for safer SD tile/path handling plus dynamic node centering, add an on-device internet/satellite map cache menu, make map/message/signal status explicit on the pager UI, add a Tools screen-correction sequence, and force physical USB API access for field recovery.

targetDevice.sdCard: 32GB installed; firmware mount not yet API-verified

lastKnownWorkingRuntime.status: Working and configured on 2026-05-29 after adding the ITSZ_FORCE_USB_SERIAL_API firmware override. The T-Deck Plus enumerated as COM17 after flash and completed Meshtastic serial API handshakes.

customBuild.ui: Low-color black/white/green palette closer to the original Meshtastic look, with explicit mesh idle, map source/GPS, and message delivery status labels.

build.status: WSL build path produced flashable t-deck-tft images. The 20260530-215349 build includes the ITSZ Classic UI skin, dynamic/safe TFT map patch, on-device internet/satellite map menu, explicit mesh idle/map source/message delivery labels, forced physical USB serial API access, recovery controls, SD message journal, and Tools -> Screen Correction. Flash completed and verified with esptool on COM16, but runtime API verification is pending because the board remained in ESP32-S3 DOWNLOAD bootloader mode.

flash.pendingReason: Flash is written. Put the T-Deck back into normal boot mode; raw serial currently reports boot:0x0 DOWNLOAD(USB/UART0), so Meshtastic API cannot answer until GPIO0/BOOT is released and the board resets normally.
